note: Mock detail data for Vigil protocol pages. Values grounded in mid-2026 public data (DeFiLlama, L2Beat, CoinGecko, news) but are illustrative, not live. Each signal carries a `source` and `status` so unsourceable ones can be dropped without breaking the health-score calc. Optional sections (contracts/incidents/dependencies) may be empty per protocol.
signalConvention: normalized ∈ [0,1] where 1 = healthy, 0 = critical. weight = contribution to health score, normalized so weights sum to 1.0 across all signals per protocol.
